# LEWAM

> LEWAM is a recurring ETB billing infrastructure demo for Telebirr mandate enrollment, renewals, invoice state, and graceful payment recovery.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://lewam.pro.et/
- Developer documentation: https://lewam.pro.et/docs.html

## Product summary

- LEWAM demonstrates recurring subscription billing for Ethiopian businesses.
- The flow covers one-time mandate authorization, monthly renewal, invoice state, and retry scheduling.
- The public experience is a sandbox demonstration. It does not move real money.

## Documentation

The developer guide describes the staging API shape, webhook events, error handling, security boundaries, and production onboarding considerations:

- https://lewam.pro.et/docs.html

## Source and identity

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/kirawebdesigner/lewam
- Operator: Kirubel Daniel

## Accuracy note

Treat sandbox behavior and demo credentials as non-production examples. Do not infer live payment authorization, merchant approval, or financial guarantees from this site.
